title: docs(tooling): the handler-key gate names the owner its ledger consults, in all three places (objectui#9456)
body:
Fixes #9456

`scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` forward-routed the live `onTabChange` disposition to **objectui#9344's item ②**. That card closed `completed` on 2026-09-13 having landed its item ① (the cast receiver the census now peels) and **not** its item ② — the two ledger rows are still exemptions, so the disposition is live and the pointer sent every reader to a closed card.

The owner the code actually consults is `objectui#7804`: it is the value both rows carry, and the changeset of the very slice that added them already says so —

```
.changeset/handler-key-reads-follow-cast-receivers.md:6
  Their per-key disposition is not decided here — both are ledgered to
  objectui#7804, which owns it.
```

## What changed — comments only, three sites not one

The card named one. A sweep of every disposition this gate routes found **three** prose sites carrying the same dead pointer:

| site | what it said |
| --- | --- |
| `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`, alias-shape block | "`detail::DetailSchema.onTabChange` … its disposition is objectui#9344's item ②" |
| `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`, `onTabChange` block | "Deciding either is objectui#9344's item ②" |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts` | "That is objectui#9344's item ②" — the copy the card predicted, in the gate's own pin |

All three now name `objectui#7804`. ⛔ Nothing here says either disposition is **decided** — `'detail'` is still undecided and still lands in the zod arms, not in this file.

The `onTabChange` block also still said the `'tabs'` row "may be an ALIAS question rather than a declaration one" while **the same file, ~110 lines above**, records that question as ANSWERED (the alias is the REGISTRATION's, `skipFallback: true` under a namespace, objectui#9573's shape). That self-contradiction is resolved in the same stroke; the row's value is untouched, and the block states plainly that objectui#9573 names the row's **shape**, not a second owner in this ledger.

⛔ The four historical mentions the card ring-fenced (what objectui#9344 measured, what it taught `handlerReadsIn`, what it **ruled**, and the `erasedReceiverName` docblock) are untouched. A ruling reference stays correct as history even though the card that carried it is closed.

## The sweep, with a control

Instrument: for each row in `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS`, the owner **the code consults** is the tuple's second element; attribute each row to its governing comment block and compare against every `objectui#NNNN` that block names.

| | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rows whose governing block cites the owner the code consults | **11 / 14** | **13 / 14** |
| rows whose block does not | 3 | 1 |

**The control is the 11** — `button::`, `icon::`, the four `form::`, the five `list::` — read by the same method, same run, and correctly described both before and after. So the 3 are a reading, not a dead instrument.

The one remaining MISMATCH is **not** this defect and is **not** repaired here: `grid::GridSchema.onNavigate` has **no describing prose at all**. Its governing block describes the *drained* `object-grid::ObjectGridSchema.onNavigate` row and never names the surviving row, so the instrument scores it as "block does not cite `objectui#7804`" while nothing in the file claims a *wrong* owner for it. An undescribed row, not a misdescribed one — recorded in Acceptance notes.

## Verification — at `d8da96120`

| leg | command | result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the gate itself | `pnpm check:handler-key-reads` | `OK 105 arm(s), 212 registration(s) … 60 judged … 14 exempted by ledger` — `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| the gate's pin | `npx vitest run --project unit scripts/__tests__/check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts` | **30 passed (30)** — `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| types | `pnpm type-check:scripts` | exit 0 |
| control bytes | `pnpm check:control-bytes` | `OK (scanned 7785 tracked text file(s))` |
| comment masking | `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | exit 0, residue unchanged at the objectui#7882 ceiling |
| new line citations | `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `0 new citation(s) … exit 0` |
| doc-example readers | `pnpm check:doc-example-readers` | `OK 81 documented symbol(s), 4107 call site(s)` |
| changeset | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` — its own verdict line, exit 0 |
| governed surface | `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test …` | `NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) … none matched` |

The census numbers are **unchanged** in both directions: 60 judged reads, 14 exemptions, 30 pin tests. That is the point — this diff moves prose and nothing else.

### Lint, as a declared narrowing

`pnpm lint` here is `turbo run lint`, whose population is **46 packages** (`node scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` → `46/46 packages linted`). `scripts/` has no `package.json`, so **neither changed file is in that population at all** — the same reason `type-check:scripts` exists as a separate task. Both files were linted directly against the root `eslint.config.js` anyway: `--format json` reports **2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings**. Type-aware linting is **not** enabled in that config (no `projectService`, no `project:`, no `typeChecked`), so no rule resolves types across files and this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it did not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- **`grid::GridSchema.onNavigate` carries no describing prose.** Its governing comment block is entirely about the drained `object-grid::` row it replaced. Not a wrong owner and not this card's class; noted so the next reader of that block knows the row below it is unattributed.
- **The gate has no mechanical guard against this class.** Triage recorded the class itself (three guards, two repos, one failure mode: a gate's prose outliving the rule it describes) on objectstack#18507 rather than filing a fourth instance card, so that card is the carrier and this PR does not add a pin. Mechanising the sweep above would need the `grid::` row described first.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

> 席位意见留空,由评审席定稿。

**改了什么** —— 门禁脚本 `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` 和它的 pin 测试里,三处注释把一个**尚未定夺**的 disposition 指向了 objectui#9344 —— 那张卡 2026-09-13 已 closed `completed`,而它的 item ② 并没有落地。三处现在都改为指向 `objectui#7804`,也就是台账每一行自己带的那张卡。⛔ 只改注释,没有任何一行台账、任何一个 zod arm、任何一条判定发生变化。

**为什么改** —— 这个门禁的自述是承重的:它的错误信息教人「把 key 加进 KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS,附上拥有该修复的卡」。当注释指向一张已关的卡,下一个读者就被送去一个死胡同。这不是孤例:同一个死指针已经被抄进 PR objectui#9343 的测试注释和正文,并在那里熬过两轮修补才被评审抓到。⇒ 它是个**源头**,别处在照抄。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险接近零:diff 全是注释,门禁读数逐项不变(60 judged / 14 exempted / 30 pin tests)。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,不牵动任何其他东西。唯一的判断是「谁是正确的 owner」,而这一点有三份互相独立的证据支持:台账行自己的值、已落地的 changeset 原文、以及 2026-09-17 `domain:ui` 席位在 objectui#9344 上的跨卡实测。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 无需操作。normal review + merge queue;不命中受管面(已用 `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` 核过),不欠 changeset(门禁自己的判定行)。
